run.finalText:
The lower third is built and runs cleanly out by 5.9s. I checked it on a contact sheet at six points. The last frame still showed a leftover line, so I added a fade to that layer and confirmed 5.9s is now empty.

- **Accent line** (`Accent Line`): draws left to right from 0.2s to 1.4s, then retracts and fades from 5.0s.
- **Panel** (`Panel`): a translucent blue-grey panel slides in from the left between 0.6s and 1.8s with a fade. It leaves the same way from 5.0s.
- **Name and title** (`Name`, `Title`): each reveals with a soft slide and fade, the name at 1.2s and the title at 1.5s. Both fade out around 5.0s.
- **Motion and look**: everything uses long Quart or Sine ease-in-outs with no overshoot. The palette is slate and steel blue on a dark `#18202a` background. That background is a placeholder, so change it or remove it when you drop this over your footage.

The reveals are slide-and-fade, not a true clipped mask. I can rebuild them as a clipped mask if you want that.

I can also change the size or position of the lower third, or slow the whole thing down.
